one_line: Anthropic targets a $1.4 trillion valuation in its upcoming IPO, while Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon and OpenAI reports rising enterprise revenue.

themes.title: Anthropic sets IPO for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
themes.text: Anthropic filed an updated prospectus to offer 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78 each, targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion. The offering includes massive private investments from tech giants like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Google, alongside plans by co-founders to sell $1.75 billion in stock.

themes.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon and new TPUs
themes.text: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon with an agent swarm feature via its API and apps. Alongside the model release, Google introduced two new eighth-generation TPU variants, the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, focused on confidential computing and large-scale workloads.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to the public with agent swarm feature
Google unveils TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and large-scale AI workloads

themes.title: OpenAI reports strong enterprise revenue and launches busine
themes.text: OpenAI reported $10 billion in revenue for the third quarter of 2026, driven by enterprise demand for APIs and models like GPT-5.6 and Astra. Additionally, the company launched a beta Business Hub allowing businesses to create verified profiles and custom Business Agents.
